description: An external attacker conducted a brute force attack against a corporate user account. Over a period of approximately two hours, the attacker generated multiple failed authentication attempts from a single IP address. The activity triggered IDS alerts for brute force and credential attack behavior. Eventually, the attacker successfully authenticated to the target account, indicating a likely account compromise.

attack_steps.description: Attacker begins authentication attempts against a corporate user account.
Multiple failed login attempts detected from the same external IP.
IDS identifies repeated authentication failures matching brute force attack behavior.
IDS escalates alert after continued failed authentication attempts.
Authentication succeeds after numerous failed attempts.
Account activity observed immediately after successful authentication, suggesting potential compromise.

rule_1.name: Multiple Failed Logins
rule_1.description: Detect repeated failed login attempts from the same source IP.

rule_2.name: Brute Force Followed by Successful Login
rule_2.description: Correlate failed login clusters with a successful login from the same source IP.

rule_3.name: IDS Brute Force Correlation
rule_3.description: Correlate IDS brute force alerts with Windows failed login events.

rule_4.name: Credential Attack Detection
rule_4.description: Correlate IDS credential attack alerts with failed login activity.

observed_patterns: Repeated login attempts from a single IP address

recommended_actions.description: Temporarily disable the affected account until investigation is completed.
Force password reset and invalidate active sessions.
Add the source IP address to firewall and IDS block lists.
Require multi-factor authentication for affected and privileged accounts.
Investigate additional authentication activity related to the account.

executive_summary: A high-severity brute force attack was detected against a corporate user account. The attacker generated numerous failed authentication attempts from a single external IP address, triggering IDS alerts for brute force and credential attack activity. The attack eventually resulted in a successful login, indicating a likely account compromise. Immediate containment actions include account disablement, credential reset, IP blocking, and enforcement of multi-factor authentication. The incident has been assigned a risk score of 85 due to the confirmed successful authentication following sustained attack activity.
